scientific_integrity: Proof is analytical; a stand-alone checker independently verifies an exact curvature witness and finite identities. Published full-text prior source is credited even where a visual inference is contradicted. No independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Equal positive exponential rates, ordinary bivariate FGM survival copula; exact threshold is a one-variable maximization. Numerical decimal is exploratory. Full-text priority of Navarro–Sarabia (2020) not established; no unique maximizer asserted.
title: Sharp likelihood-ratio aging boundary for sums of two FGM-dependent exponentials
